denominator: Prediction–observation pairs from 12 unshuffled observational test samples. F1, precision and recall refer to the hypoxic class. All seven configurations use the source Table 3 comparison.

geography.unit: Louisiana–Texas continental shelf, northern Gulf of Mexico; regional model validation
geography.definition: Louisiana–Texas continental shelf, northern Gulf of Mexico; regional model validation
geography.anchorRule: Use an explicitly non-geographic sphere or global band. No national fill, fake city locations, or inferred unobserved distribution.

time.updateCadence: Frozen research snapshot; recheck source before any update, not a live feed

sources.title: Forecasting coastal hypoxia using a blend of mechanistic and artificial intelligence models
sources.locator: Tables 1 and 3; official full text XML PMC12381083

reuse.basis: Limited extraction of numerical facts; source article is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
reuse.attribution: Forecasting coastal hypoxia using a blend of mechanistic and artificial intelligence models — Ou et al., Scientific Reports
reuse.notes: The article licence restricts commercial use and distribution of adaptations. This pack contains only a small independent structured transcription of factual findings, without article prose, figures or adapted article content. No CC BY licence is claimed for the source; reuse outside this narrow factual extraction requires separate assessment.

coverage.population: Louisiana–Texas continental shelf, northern Gulf of Mexico; regional model validation
coverage.included: 28 populated records; inclusion is defined by the exact source locator in every row
coverage.omitted: Operational 2026 risk maps, other oceans, actual sample coordinates, independent unseen-year validation and prospectively prevented harm.
coverage.missingness: Unobserved or unpublished is not zero; omitted places/classes have no inferred values.

uncertainty: Methods and Table 4 specify 12 unshuffled summer test samples from 2007–2019 excluding 2016; Table 3 caption instead says 2007–2020. Retain this source inconsistency and do not animate yearly results. Training/validation augmentation spatially shuffles observations from 1994–2020 excluding 2016, apparently including test-era years: overlap/leakage risk prevents a claim of unseen-year generalization. Table 3 temporal quantiles are not confidence intervals on pooled metrics.

transform.description: Transcribed selected published factual findings into a normalized long table; values retain source precision. No interpolation or score normalization.
transform.validation: Row-level source locators; numerical bounds and schema checked locally; independent review pending.

verification.method: Primary publication/table read and values transcribed, with comparison to source metadata; independent acceptance pending.

scoring.reason: No defensible common 1–100 extremity construct. Display source metric and uncertainty in original units.

forecast.reason: No original future extrapolation; any model evaluations are retrospective results only.
